asides.note: Farmer's Night petting zoo, milking contest

asides.text: A quick note from producer Phil. A warm greeting from all of us at WSLP to the good people at the Bel-Air Area Historical Society in Bel Air, Michigan. They are doing good work with their mission of telling it like it was and we thank them for listening.
And producer Phil is over reporting that the Cars-Ravens game this evening has been rained out. So they'll have to make that one up tomorrow evening.

And now the cows are being brought out onto the field for the Farmer's Night milking contest. And it looks like the big man Tiny Howl will represent the Bombers. And for the Tigers, Prudence Jefferson.
The grounds crew is still cleaning up the detritus from the Farmer's Night activities. And this may be the last time that livestock will be allowed on the field here at Evermore Park.
